brief:
Former President Donald Trump rejected claims that the military faces ammunition shortages, according to Drop Site News. Trump pledged to prosecute individuals responsible for disclosing information about weapons stockpiles to news outlets, characterizing the leaks as threats to national security and vowing jail time for those involved.

An Israeli settler was charged with killing a Palestinian in what would represent a rare prosecution in the long-running conflict. The charge comes amid broader tensions between Israeli and Palestinian communities. In a separate development, the Senate voted to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt, furthering Republican efforts to hold the former pandemic health official accountable for decisions made during his tenure.
title: Trump denies munitions shortages, threatens prosecution of leakers
